message.content: {"caption":"A two-part figure showing a skill-learning workflow and success-rate curves over training.","description":"The upper panel (a) is a pipeline diagram. A robot icon labeled “Base Model” is linked by paired curved arrows to a computer icon labeled “Environment”; a right-pointing arrow leads to a branching “Trajectory” symbol. The upper branch goes to a green check mark and the lower branch to a red X. Colored arrows from both marks lead to a document-like icon labeled “Expert,” whose orange arrow points to a stacked-books icon labeled “Memory.” A right-pointing arrow connects Memory to a folder labeled “Skills.” Gray dashed routes also show the checked branch going directly toward Memory and the crossed branch toward a trash-bin icon labeled “Discard.” At the lower right, two small robot icons are connected by red circular arrows beside the label “Evolve.” The lower panel (b) is a line chart with Training Steps on the x-axis (0–150) and Success Rate (%) on the y-axis (0–100). Its legend identifies blue “Vanilla GRPO,” gray dashed “GRPO+Memory,” and red “SkillRL (Ours).” SkillRL climbs fastest and levels off near 90%; Vanilla GRPO rises more gradually to about 75%, while GRPO+Memory levels off around the low 60s. A small annotation marks “Higher Performance” and “Faster Convergence.” Colored markers and faint dashed guide lines highlight points on the curves.
